title: Anti-restrictions gathering at Heroes’ Square
participants_original: 24.hu estimated about 1,000 participants at Hősök tere; it said most did not wear masks.
threshold_50_evidence: 24.hu reports approximately 1,000 participants at the Hősök tere rally. Telex independently describes the square toward Oktogon as nearly full but gives no numeric count. The approximate 24.hu estimate supports the >=50 threshold; no interval is derived.

title.summary: Opened Telex and 24.hu reporting confirms the February 28 Gődény rally at Hősök tere, Budapest.

start_date.summary: 24.hu dates the report to February 28 and says the rally was held Sunday morning; no exact event start time is given.

location.summary: Both opened reports identify Heroes’ Square (Hősök tere), Budapest; Telex locates the main gathering on the side toward Oktogon.

organizer.summary: Both opened reports identify György Gődény as organizer.

demands.summary: The event call opposed compulsory vaccination and mask wearing; 24.hu reports Gődény said he would deliver a letter to the Prime Minister’s Office and expected a reply.

participants_estimate.summary: 24.hu estimates about 1,000 participants; the original wording is approximate and no min/max interval is inferred.

state_response.summary: 24.hu reports police identity checks and Gődény being identified for event organization and mask-rule violations. Gődény then declared the gathering over and asked attendees to go home. The sources do not establish arrest or forceful dispersal.

end_date.summary: 24.hu reports Gődény announced the event was over after police arrived and asked people to go home; Telex says the main gathering ended before a smaller group moved to Vajdahunyad Castle. Neither source establishes exact time or complete physical clearance, so end date remains unknown.

participants_precision.summary: 24.hu uses an approximate estimate (“about 1,000”); the numeric participants_estimate is a reported approximation, not an exact count or range.

notes: Opened 24.hu reporting supplies an approximate estimate of about 1,000 at this assembly; Telex independently describes a near-full square without a number. Do not pool this estimate with the later Vajdahunyad Castle group. Police identification checks are not coded as arrests or forceful dispersal. Episode linkage with the later physical assembly remains coordinator-reviewable.
open_questions: Review the episode relationship with HUN202102-E004 while keeping each physical assembly and its headcount separate.
Review the remaining state-response unknowns under the coding manual; do not infer actions from the reported police checks.
